source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 1–6 align directly with all 219 corresponding Hebrew records. Each original XML record is hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps the named event and its interpretation as destruction for following Baal.
Renders the comparative elohim phrase with a singular god while noting the possible plural gods reading.
Preserves the pivotal distinction between audible speech and unseen form.
Keeps the heavenly host and allotment claim without adding a permission for other peoples' worship.
Keeps Moses' recurring account of his exclusion and the oath's two prohibitions.
Preserves the cosmic witnesses and repeated threat without weakening the destruction language.
Retains all three assurances alongside the preceding threats without resolving their tension editorially.
Takes the singular ancestral suffix collectively with fathers; retains presence rather than inserting an angel and notes the grammatical shift.
Distinguishes unintentional killing and absence of prior hatred without treating refuge as automatic acquittal.
Preserves Sion as written here rather than silently changing it to Sirion or confusing it with Zion.
